subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus focused positive/negative unit coverage as sufficient proof for this xAI/Grok stale encrypted_content recovery, given the contributor says the exact code-less provider error cannot be induced on demand?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well localized, but ClawSweeper's external-PR gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof; only a maintainer can decide whether the provider-side trigger justifies a proof override.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the production logs, dependency/source proof, and focused tests as enough evidence for this high-impact provider recovery path, then let normal merge checks gate the PR.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future real xAI rotation event produces redacted gateway logs showing the retry succeeds.

options.title: Close or pause the mitigation
options.body: Decline the workaround until xAI exposes a reproducible contract or a broader breaker-classification design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the production logs, dependency/source proof, and focused tests as enough evidence for this high-impact provider recovery path, then let normal merge checks gate the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The proof decision is closest to the existing OpenAI Responses retry predicate that steipete introduced and merged in the prior related fix.
